tagline: Time intelligence — compare current period to the same period one year ago

slides.title: Same Period Last Year
slides.body: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR shifts the current date filter context back exactly 12 months. Whatever period the user has selected — a day, a month, a quarter — it returns the equivalent period one year earlier.
slides.keyPoint: Requires a Date table marked as a Date Table with a contiguous date range — gaps or missing years cause BLANK results.

slides.title: Report Context — Q1 2024 Selected
slides.caption: User has a year slicer set to 2024, showing Jan–Mar data
slides.note: Active filter context: DimDate[Year] = 2024, months Jan–Mar

slides.title: Defining the Measures
slides.code:
Sales LY =
CALCULATE(
    [Total Sales],
    SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DimDate[Date])
)

YoY % Change =
DIVIDE(
    [Total Sales] - [Sales LY],
    [Sales LY]
)
slides.annotation: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(DimDate[Date]) returns dates Jan–Mar 2023. CALCULATE evaluates [Total Sales] in that shifted date context.

slides.title: Result — Year-over-Year Comparison
slides.caption: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR correctly shifts each month back exactly 12 months

slides.title: Prerequisites — Must Get These Right
bullets: DimDate must be marked as a Date Table in the model (Table Tools → Mark as Date Table)
DimDate must have a contiguous date range — every single date present, no gaps
DimDate must be connected to FactSales via an active relationship on the date key
The date table should extend to Dec 31 of the current or next year — otherwise recent periods return BLANK
slides.warning: If SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR returns BLANK for all rows, the most common cause is: date table not marked as Date Table, or the date column has gaps. Check both first.

slides.title: Alternatives
bullets: DATEADD(DimDate[Date], -1, YEAR) — functionally identical for most scenarios, slightly more flexible
PREVIOUSYEAR(DimDate[Date]) — returns the entire previous calendar year regardless of current selection
PARALLELPERIOD(DimDate[Date], -1, YEAR) — similar to PREVIOUSYEAR, anchors to full period boundaries
slides.keyPoint: For the PL-300 exam: SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR is the standard expected answer for 'compare to same period last year' questions.
